text:
maya: morning team — quick handoff. Deploys: rolling canary for 3.2.1 started at 08:05 PT. watchlist: latency tail on embed service during cold starts.

samir: noted. preflight: I paused autoscaler yesterday for load test; unpaused at 08:10 PT. keep an eye on pod churn.

alex: also saw a few 502s on /v1/embeddings when kv-cache miss rate > 0.2. I pushed a small retry tweak in staging (PR #842). will merge after unit tests.

jess: leaving a note — I'm on PTO until 16:00 PT but monitoring slack. ping if canary needs rollback.

deploy-bot: canary rollout 3.2.1: 40% -> 75% (08:18 PT). no errors reported by health-checker.

maya: watch for latency > 200ms 95p on emb-service. if observed, reduce canary to 10% and tag @samir to investigate.

samir: ack. quick commands if we need to scale down:
```
# reduce canary
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://console.redwood.com/api/rollouts/3.2.1/actions -d '{"action":"set_traffic", "percent":10}'
```

alex: for 502s, first step is to check proxy logs and backend pool:
- `kubectl logs -l app=emb-proxy -n prod --tail=200`
- `kubectl get pods -l app=emb-backend -o wide`

jess: action items for next shift:
- validate A/B metrics after 1h (maya)
- merge PR #842 and monitor retry graph (alex)
- check autoscaler metrics and pod restart counts (samir)

maya: FYI — prefetched KV-cache warmers ran at 07:50 PT and caused a short resource spike. we adjusted concurrency to 8 to avoid pressure.

oncall-bot: alert suppression active for warmers from 07:45-08:30 PT per SRE.

samir: leaving a watch note: GC pauses spiked on one instance (i-0a1b2c3d). I put it in maintenance group; will follow up with infra team.

maya: thanks. if anyone sees >5% error rate on /v1/generate roll back immediately and notify #incidents. Otherwise, normal ops. good handoff.

alex: pinging @jess on PR #842 tests flakey in CI, heads up.

jess: saw that — rerunning.

maya: end of thread — last check-in 08:24 PT.
